'''Nici''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as an [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] at the [[Theed Hangar/Legends|Theed Hangar]] on [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]<ref name="TPM" /> around [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> That year, the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invaded]] Naboo. Nici was held captive in a corner of the hangar by a squad of battle droids, along with several guards, pilots and fellow engineers. They were freed by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], who sought to escape occupied Naboo with [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala]].<ref name="TPM" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Personality and traits==
A Human with rosy skin, Nici had dark [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and a dimple in his chin. Like all engineers attached to the Royal Security Forces, they wore the issued yellow [[Jumpsuit/Legends|jumpsuit]] and [[Armor/Legends|helmet]].<ref name="TPM" />

==Behind the scenes==
This article assumes that inscribed [[Armor/Legends|helmets]] of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] correspond to their wearers' names, following the example of [[Simon Jabesq]], whose helmet reads "Simon" in [[Futhork/Legends|Futhork]], when using the symbol-to-letter correspondence from ''The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia''.<ref name="E1VG">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref><ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|299|Futhork}}</ref>
